## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the existing style; no added runtime dependencies.
- [ ] `pytest` passes.
- [ ] `ruff check src tests` passes.
- [ ] `mypy` passes.
- [ ] `mkdocs build` builds cleanly (docstrings updated if public API changed).
- [ ] Tests added/updated for any behaviour change.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated (notably if the OTP output or public API changes).
- [ ] If this changes OTP output or the public API, it is flagged as a
      **breaking change** and documented.
